note: From the original description by Ahmad 1965 (in English). The alate and soldier are described; the soldier measurements are from the holotype lot only, and no measurement table is given for the alate. Type locality Huay Yang, Thailand. The text was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; a few letter forms are wrong, but the numbers have been checked.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown; postclypeus paler than the head; antennae brown with the tip of each segment white; pronotum the same colour as the head, the disc with a T-shaped mark. Head densely hairy; postclypeus with short hairs and a few long setae; labrum sparsely hairy; pronotum as densely hairy as the head. Head circular; fontanelle distinct, oval, white. Compound eyes circular, projecting, their lower margin about 1/6 of the eye diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli large, broadly oval, their distance from the compound eye less than their short diameter. Postclypeus raised, length greater than half its width. Mandibles as shown in the figure. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 distinctly longer than segment 3, segment 3 shortest. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, length slightly greater than half its width; anterior margin straight; posterior margin concave in the middle.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow; apex of the frontal process and the anterolateral corners of the head capsule reddish brown; labrum yellow with a brownish tinge, margins transparent; mandibles dark reddish brown; antennae pale brown; thorax, legs and abdomen pale. Head sparsely hairy, the frontal process with a few long fine hairs; anterior half of the labrum with a few short hairs; pronotum sparsely hairy. Head rectangular, the median suture invisible; middle of the dorsal surface of the head depressed, with another depression near the apex of the frontal process; frontal process conical in dorsal view, slightly turned up, its apex narrowly rounded and not pointed, in lateral view the anterior margin to the notch almost a straight line. Labrum with parallel sides, anterior margin slightly convex; anterolateral corners extended into short lateral processes. Mandibles long and slender, slightly asymmetrical; left mandible curved, its apex incurved into a hook; right mandible less curved, its apex incurved. Anterior part of the postmentum about 1.5 times as wide as the posterior part, the narrowest point below the middle. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 not distinctly longer than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 subequal. Pronotum small, saddle-shaped, neither anterior nor posterior margin concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Soldier holotype: head length (to the apex of the frontal process) 1.48; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.35; head width 0.93; head height 0.80; frontal process length 0.17; left mandible length 0.71; postmentum length 0.59; postmentum maximum width 0.26, minimum width 0.20; pronotum length 0.28, width 0.62.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate can be distinguished from the other Termes species of the Indo-Malayan region by its distinctly larger body size.
